correctness.rationale: For u,v>=1 the torus fixes monomial ambient ideals containing (x^u y^v), in bijection with partitions λ with λ_(v+1)<=u. Euler localization reduces each invariant constructible µ stratum to this finite torus-fixed combinatorics at each colength. Ambient minimal generator count is 1+number of distinct positive row lengths; in the quotient exactly one generator disappears iff λ_v>u and λ_(v+1)=u. Splitting k parts >u gives B_u(q,z) and q-binomial upper factor T_(u,k); the corner correction yields the exact two-variable formula. For any finite-colength ideal, not merely monomial ideals, x+y is a nonzerodivisor and length(R/(x+y))=u+v, so from exact sequence length(I/(x+y)I)=u+v and µ(I)<=u+v. Three disjoint maximal-corner classes telescope to q^choose(u+v,2)/(P_u P_v). Independent direct Young diagram enumeration checks top-generator coefficients for all u,v=1..3 through colength16; notably (2,2) coefficients at n6,7,8 are 1,2,5. Infinite claims follow combinatorial and exact-sequence proofs.
